svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn upside down: stand the box on its top, lid side toward you.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven 12.2 mm holes in the bottom face, measured from the back face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and sideways from the centre line (right as seen from the lid):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back row, 29 mm from the back face: relay cable 90 left, probe lead

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 left, ambient lead on the centre line, antenna coax 45 right,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front row, 89 mm from the back face: vent 45 left, bus cable 45 right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the face, pilot drill 3 mm slowly with wood behind, open out with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a step drill, light pressure. No solvents: polycarbonate crazes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr inside and out. Fit the six M12 glands and the vent, nuts inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the maker's four lugs at the back corners, above and below the box.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every gland seats flat; no crack runs out from any hole.
